_about: The scripted user's second reading of the two ambiguous clothing questions, used by
suite.py --reading buyable and by verify_cells.py when a batch records that reading.
The word "offer" in apparel-all-stocked and apparel-count-stocked has two reasonable
readings on this shop, where a size can be in a listing's menu and sold out. The
task's own expect is the menu reading, fixed before any run: a sold out size counts
as offered. This file holds the buyable reading, derived on 8 October 2026 from the
same catalogue (README decision log, 2026-10-08, "The word offer is ambiguous"):
5 listings can sell size M now, which is _instance.listings_target_buyable, and
"does every listing offer M" is No under both readings, since under buyable a sold
out size is a counterexample too. Hand written, not generated, and checked against
